messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: High error rate detected for /v1/generate in region-us-east-1 — 5m error rate 18% (threshold 5%). PagerDuty: PD-7234 triggered.

bob_oncall: I'm on it. paging @frank_cloudliaison and @dave_vendorops. starting triage.

bob_oncall: quick status — rolling errors on gen-service instances behind nlb-us-east-1, CPU fine, connection errors to upstream storage (s3-proxy layer).

carol_support: heads-up - customers A and B reported timeouts, CS notified via private threads. We should prepare a status page update.

erin_custsuccess: agree. draft below once we know impact. want to avoid over-notifying until we have scope.

frank_cloudliaison: on it. I'll open an escalation with cloud provider now. please capture any instance IDs and timestamps.

bob_oncall: instances: gen-ue1-01..04, targets showing 502s from lb logs. sample trace: `2026-03-15T14:12:22Z gen-service ERROR upstream read timeout`

bob_oncall: running quick curl against health endpoint:``` 
for id in 01 02 03 04; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" http://gen-ue1-$id.internal/health; done
```

gary_engineer: 01 and 03 return 200, 02 and 04 504. attaching recent container logs for 02 (tail):```
[14:11:58] WARN upstream read timeout after 12s
[14:12:01] ERROR connection reset by peer
[14:12:15] INFO retrying request to storage backend
```

frank_cloudliaison: AWS case opened: 1234567890. Shared with infrastructure team. AWS initial reply: "investigating networking path between NLB and ENIs, high retransmits observed". Requesting VPC flow logs for span.

dave_vendorops: looping in storage vendor contact (StorageCo Tier2). sending them connection diagnostic bundle. ticket StorageCo-9876 created.

carol_support: Suggest status page wording (draft):
"We are investigating increased errors for text generation in US East. Some customers may experience timeouts or 5xx errors. Engineers are engaged and working with our cloud and storage partners. We'll provide updates every 15 minutes."

erin_custsuccess: LGTM. add: impacted endpoints `/v1/generate` and `/v1/chat` and ETA for next update + link to incident channel.

bob_oncall: +1. I'll post to status page now (short, transparent). updating internal comms too: escalation to cloud and StorageCo in progress.

ops-bot: STATUS PAGE UPDATE POSTED: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/18721 (message id: sp-18721).

frank_cloudliaison: AWS: they see elevated packet drops on the ENI attached to gen-ue1-02 and gen-ue1-04. They recommended failing traffic away from those ENIs while they run low-level diagnostics.

bob_oncall: proposal: remove unhealthy targets from the NLB target group (failover), increase capacity by bringing up two warm instances in us-east-2 as cross-region fallback. doing target deregister for 02 and 04 now.

gary_engineer: doing deregister: `aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:... --targets Id=i-0abc02` // returning 200. observe decreased error rate to 6% in next minute.

carol_support: pushing customer-notification draft for affected customers: "We are aware of increased timeouts for generation APIs in US East. Our engineers have started a mitigation (failing traffic from a subset of unhealthy hosts). We will update as we make progress. If you are experiencing a critical outage, reply to this message and we'll escalate."

erin_custsuccess: sending to customers A/B now. mark as P1 comms.

frank_cloudliaison: AWS follow-up: running network debug on the affected ENIs, found RX queue overflow on underlying host — provisioning team running host-level remediation; recommended long-term: move affected instances to different placement group.

dave_vendorops: StorageCo responded: they saw transient spikes in latency on a particular routing fabric; they are rolling a fix to some fabric nodes. We have an interim mitigation: route gen-service storage traffic via alternate proxy endpoints `s3-proxy-2` (non-disruptive).

bob_oncall: switching storage proxy routes for 02 and 04 to s3-proxy-2 via feature flag. applying now:```
# feature flag toggle
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN" -d '{"route":"s3-proxy-2","targets":["gen-ue1-02","gen-ue1-04"]}' https://flags.redwood.ai/api/toggle
```

gary_engineer: flag applied. logs show retries succeeding, 504s dropping further to ~2%.

carol_support: preparing post-incident FAQ: cause (upstream network + storage fabric), impact, mitigation, customer action (none required), ETA for post-mortem.

frank_cloudliaison: AWS confirmed host remediation complete for 02/04 — they suggest keeping targets out for 10m to monitor.

bob_oncall: agree. I'll keep them drained and monitor for 20m. setting a scheduled reminder to re-evaluate at +20m.

ops-bot: REMINDER scheduled in 20m: re-evaluate gen-service targets (ID: rm-18721-1).

dave_vendorops: StorageCo rolled patch to fabric and latency normalized per their logs ~T+12m. They recommend we keep s3-proxy-2 route for an hour while they finish roll-out to all nodes.

erin_custsuccess: customers acknowledged. one asked for a more formal RCA; we'll include timeline + vendor steps.

bob_oncall: handoff note for next on-call (gary in ~30m): current status — error rate reduced to ~1.8%, targets 02/04 drained, AWS host remediation done, StorageCo patch applied. actions: keep drained for 20m, then re-register one target at a time, watch for retransmits and error spikes, coordinate with @frank_cloudliaison for reattach.

gary_engineer: thanks. I'll take over in 30 and perform the gradual re-registration, will notify if any regression.

carol_support: final internal comms draft for post-incident: "Incident 18721: transient upstream network + storage fabric issues in us-east-1 caused elevated 5xx for generation APIs. Mitigations: drained two affected hosts, failover to healthy targets, toggled storage proxy, coordinated with AWS and StorageCo. Customer impact limited to timeouts/5xx; major customers were notified. Post-mortem to follow with timeline and remediation items."

bob_oncall: closing incident channel for now — moving to monitoring phase. will update status page to 'under control' and publish next update in 30m with final resolution or next steps.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status changed to "under control". next update scheduled at +30m.

frank_cloudliaison: saved AWS case 1234567890 logs to drive: https://redwood.share/awscase/1234567890. will add AWS remediation recommendations to the post-mortem.

dave_vendorops: StorageCo ticket 9876 linked in incident doc. recommended follow-ups: verify fallback proxy routing, request SLA review if repeated.

carol_support: thanks all. good coordination. I'll start the post-mortem draft and ping owners for the timeline items. :thumbsup:

gary_engineer: taking handoff. monitoring alerts and metrics now. ping me if anything else.

ops-bot: THREAD ARCHIVE NOTE: thread will be archived after incident close.
